environment.description: ECS Fargate task in us-west-2, task role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/app-service-role-prod with IAM permission boundary arn:aws:iam::112233445566:policy/EnforcedBoundary-RestrictExec attached. The boundary policy has an explicit Deny on s3:PutObject when aws:ResourceTag/classification is not 'internal', combined with an SCP (id: scp-0a8b3c4d5e) on the OU that denies iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary, iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary, and iam:DetachRolePolicy for any principal in the account. The permission boundary also contains a conditional Deny on all actions when the request originates from a source IP not in the VPC CIDR (condition: aws:VpcSourceIp not in 10.0.0.0/8), effectively preventing the execSync results from being exfiltrated via S3 since the PutObject call would require the backup bucket to have the classification=internal tag AND the call must originate from within the VPC. The container also runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in task definition) meaning execSync cannot write temp files or spawn shells that require /tmp access, and the ECS task has no exec permissions (ECS Exec disabled via execute-command-configuration set to NONE).
